tables.name: Military Facilities
tables.description: Where the capital houses and trains its forces. Facilities inside the capital may be large enough to count as their own district.

results.name: Temporary Shelters Outside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses tents for all troops, and few, quickly-built minimal structures. Training grounds have been established in the landscape around the encampment.

results.name: Simple Structures Outside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses bunkhouses for troops, and quarters for officers. Training grounds have been established in the landscape around the encampment.

results.name: Moderate Structures Outside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses barracks for the troops, and separate structures for officers. Training grounds are equipped yards with light walls.

results.name: Simple Structures Inside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses barracks facilities for the troops, and quarters for officers. Training grounds are equipped drilling yards within light walls.

results.name: Moderate Structures Inside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses well-equipped and outfitted barracks facilities, as well as quarters for officers. Training grounds are well-maintained, with separate, specialist facilities, all surrounded by moderate walls.

results.name: Robust Structures Inside the Capital
results.description: This encompasses extremely well-equipped and outfitted barracks facilities, and quarters for officers. Training grounds are expansive and contain anything that could be required for high-level military training. All is protected by heavy walls.
